name: POST /api/leadflow/workflows/:id/release-gate - may this ship
description:
Evaluates the same conditions the publish endpoint enforces, WITHOUT publishing.

A reviewer needs to know whether the gate will open before they try it; finding out by being refused is how people learn to treat the refusal as noise rather than as information.

THE DRY RUN'S HEADLINE NUMBER TRAVELS WITH THE VERDICT, because may_publish: true on a rule that would send 5000 messages is a different decision from one that would send four, and a bare boolean hides which one this is.

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: No workflow version with that id
errorCases.when: the version id does not exist.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
